## 升级后保留“输入监控”授权 | Updates keep Input Monitoring access

升级后保留“输入监控”授权（从旧版升级到本版需授权一次）；启动时检查授权，缺失时提示并可一键打开系统设置。
Updates keep Input Monitoring access (one more grant is needed when updating from an earlier version). The app checks access at launch and, if it is missing, offers to open System Settings.

## 其他改进 | More improvements

- 性能 HUD 的帧率读数更准确（[#87](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/87)）。
  The Performance HUD shows more accurate frame rates ([#87](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/87)).

## 修复 | Fixes

- 修复自由鼠标在未授权“输入监控”时来回抖动，并让光标更跟手、更平滑（[#87](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/87)）。
  Fixed the free-mouse cursor jittering back and forth without Input Monitoring access, and made it follow the pointer more closely and smoothly ([#87](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/87)).
